newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland - eye of the storm.
newsitem.headline: Ireland - eye of the storm.

text.p: Ireland, a land of rain and mists, became the eye of the storm on Thursday.
Shannon, one of the most westerly points in Europe, was chosen as the centre of an international effort to improve understanding of storm patterns developing in the Atlantic.
The FASTEX (Fronts and Atlantic Storm Tracks Experiment) project, based at Shannon Airport, was formally opened by Energy Minister Emmet Stagg.
Six aircraft will be used to fly out over the Atlantic and gather data on developing storms which will form the basis of studies to be carried out in coming years.
Stagg said the aim was to make more reliable forecasts of weather patterns about to hit Europe.
